newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania industry falls by 11.3 pct in April.
newsitem.headline: Romania industry falls by 11.3 pct in April.

text.p: Romania's April industrial output dropped 11.3 percent from the previous month, mainly due to falls in the chemical sector, the National Statistics Board (CNS) said on Friday.
"Lower activity in the chemical, food and beverage industries, as well as in the extractive sector triggered the fall in output last month," CNS president Pavel Wagner told a news conference.
The manufacturing industry slumped 12 percent last month, when the extractive sector was 6.1 percent down. Output in the power sector saw a 12.1 percent fall from the previous month.
Industrial output stood at 13.41 trillion lei in April, with the four-month figure at 43.6 trillion.
Inventories accounted for 65.1 percent of April's production, up from 54.7 percent the previous month, with textiles and household appliances inventories rising the most.
Some 22 percent of April's output was exported, CNS data showed.
Industry employed 2.47 million people at end-April, 20,000 less than the previous month.
